title: Keep directory metadata filtering when coalesced raw notification kinds differ
outcome: A pending generation made only of directory metadata hints retains that classification when the raw notify kinds differ, while real namespace or file changes remain visible.
acceptance: A regression merges two different metadata-hint kinds for the same ordinary directory through production ingest/drain and verifies that the directory hint remains suppressed.
A mixed metadata plus real namespace/file-change control retains covering notification and conservative ordering; alias and reparse-point protections remain intact.
